items.title: The data directory is data/, not vault/
items.chose: rename vault/ to data/ with a migration (0037)
over: keep vault/: the name implies an Obsidian vault, which it stopped being

items.title: The shared Rust crates live in the locus repository
items.chose: fold locus-theme and eco-dates into crates/ here; kairos and keryx keep their pins until next touched
over: a separate locus-shared repository: one more repo to keep in step
a git submodule: every clone and pull has to remember it

items.title: The drop folder is organised by area
items.chose: one drop folder with a subfolder per area
over: one flat folder where the system labels what arrives: revised the same day

items.title: How the build is run
items.chose: a spec per slice approved first; mechanical steps under /goal with a printed check; design in chat; a report at the end

items.title: The plan lives in the repository
items.chose: plan.tex and info.tex in docs/redesign/, read as source
